frequency_matching.method: match DC value and first derivative at s=0; compare exact complex frequency samples
frequency_matching.boundary: same DC only ensures same constant-input final gain for stable models, not same response at every frequency

nyquist.contour: clockwise boundary of RHP; imaginary axis -jR to +jR, right semicircle back
nyquist.convention: R counts counterclockwise image windings about -1; R=P-Z
nyquist.boundary: K=1 passes through -1 at omega0; closed pole0; imaginary-axis poles need indented contour; no hidden unstable cancellation

minimum_phase_pair.boundary: stable nonminimum phase possible; improper inverse due relative degree is distinct from unstable inverse due RHP zero

convention_boundaries.negativeGain: -1 has no finite zeros/poles but extra 180deg relative to +1; source typical-element convention treats it separately
convention_boundaries.originElements: textbook frequency-element convention includes 1/s and s; they are not examples with all roots strictly LHP and stable proper inverse
convention_boundaries.delay: exp(-tau*s) has unit magnitude and phase -omega*tau; inverse time advance is noncausal
convention_boundaries.unstablePole: 1/(s-1) is unstable regardless of lack of finite zeros; stable-minimum-phase usage excludes it
